title: N-th Order Differential Equation Solver
description: Desktop application built in Python that solves n-th order equations (Cauchy-Euler, Variation of Parameters) with step-by-step LaTeX output.
longDescription: This project was born from the need to automate the resolution of complex differential equations in an academic setting. The software accepts n-th order equations and automatically selects the most suitable solving method (Undetermined Coefficients, Variation of Parameters, or Cauchy-Euler), with support for initial value conditions.

title: AI Image Restoration Workflow
description: Automated ComfyUI pipeline for upscaling and restoring old photographs using diffusion models and face-aware reconstruction.
longDescription: An AI workflow designed to transform blurry images into high-definition pieces (2K/4K). Unlike traditional upscaling, this system understands the image and reconstructs it in three phases: 1. Physical stage — enlarges the image mathematically. 2. Artistic stage (global) — refines textures and lighting without altering composition. 3. Surgical stage (faces) — detects faces and rebuilds them in high definition.

title: Data Analysis: Attention Span in Students
description: Statistical research on the correlation between short-form social media usage and cognitive attention in engineering students.
longDescription: A quantitative study analyzing digital behavior patterns in university students. Data mining techniques were used to identify significant correlations between screen time and academic performance, including an OLS regression model (R² = 0.692) and a critical exposure threshold.

title: Hybrid RAG with RAGAS Evaluation
description: Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation system combining dense and sparse semantic search, with automated quality evaluation.
longDescription: End-to-end development of a hybrid RAG pipeline combining dense (vector) and sparse (BM25/TF-IDF) retrieval. The system includes an automated evaluation module using the RAGAS framework to quantitatively measure faithfulness, answer relevancy, and context precision. The architecture covers FAISS indexing, prompt management with LangChain, and an automatic evaluator that produces per-query quality metrics stored in metrics.json for traceability.
